name: Omid Analyzer
label: OMID ANALYZER
title: Omid Analyzer.
lede: A brand for Omid Financial Group, who have run algorithmic trading and market-making in Iran’s capital market since 2015 — built to read in Persian and Latin at once.

problem.label: THE PROBLEM
problem.title: It had to read as serious to a trader and as legible to someone new to markets — in two scripts, across three products.
paragraphs: Omid Analyzer talks to two rooms at once: people who already trade and want density, and people new to markets who need the same numbers explained. Both have to believe the same thing before they use anything — that this is a serious place to put money.

A financial brand lives on screens that are almost entirely numbers, so the identity gets a couple of seconds at the top of a page and then disappears under data. And it had to hold in Persian and Latin, under three product names, without any of them looking like a different company.

items.title: Drew the wordmark in Persian and Latin as one design, not two.
items.text: Persian and Latin share no baseline, stroke rhythm or optical centre. I matched them on weight and height rather than letterform, giving up some of the Persian’s stroke contrast so the pair reads as one mark at the same size.

items.title: Gave the product family one system: OMIDMax, OMIDHub, OMIDPlus.
items.text: One construction stays fixed — the mark, the OMID lockup, the spacing — and only the suffix changes. A fourth product is a word, not a redraw.

items.title: Used the galaxy to say the market is a system, not noise.
items.text: Trading brands sell chaos: red and green candles, arrows, urgency. The nebula says the opposite — vast, ordered, readable from a distance. It stays dark and out of focus, so type always sits on top of it rather than in it.

outcome.label: OUTCOME
outcome.title: It launched, and the family still holds.
outcome.text: The brand is live on omid.ir: the galaxy world, the bilingual wordmark and the one-construction family went live with it, and Omid Financial Group has been running algorithmic trading and market-making in Iran’s capital market since 2015.
